Sandbox_RustRemover_enabled_tooltip: Allow players to remove visual vehicle rust using Rust Remover and Sandpaper.
Sandbox_RustRemover_rustPercentPerPass_t: The percentage of a vehicle's visual rust removed by one completed treatment.
Sandbox_RustRemover_baseActionTime_toolt: Timed-action duration at Mechanics level 0. The default 600 is a deliberately slow 10-minute treatment.
Sandbox_RustRemover_bottleUsePercent_too: The percentage drained from a Rust Remover bottle for each treatment.
Sandbox_RustRemover_sandpaperConditionLo: The percentage of a Sandpaper sheet's maximum condition lost per treatment.
Sandbox_RustRemover_mechanicsTimeReducti: How much each Mechanics level shortens treatment time. Total reduction is capped at 50%%.
